aiPrivacyRouter.ollamaEndpoint.description: Loopback HTTP Ollama origin only; remote hosts and redirects are rejected.

aiPrivacyRouter.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each local model request.

aiPrivacyRouter.verifierModel.description: Optional second locally installed model for the verification pass. Empty uses the review model.

aiPrivacyRouter.mandatoryLocalOnly.description: Prevent all cloud routing through this extension, including reviewed public prompts and review-only override approvals.

aiPrivacyRouter.requireReviewer.description: Require verified reviewer approval. No identity provider is connected, so enabling this prevents cloud routing and override approvals.

aiPrivacyRouter.routingMode.description: Local-only by default. Hybrid mode offers Copilot only for complex, explicitly approved typed public prompts in an empty window with no project or files open. Never filters independent Copilot usage.

aiPrivacyRouter.fixMavenImage.description: Preloaded local Maven image for the offline Java fix verifier. Resolved to its local immutable image ID; never pulled automatically. Choose a JDK matching your project.

aiPrivacyRouter.fixMavenCache.description: Optional prepopulated local Maven repository. Empty uses ~/.m2/repository. Each run privately copies and hashes at most 4 GB/100,000 files, then mounts that snapshot read-only.
